topic: Strategic Methods: How to Pursue Strategies
subject: business-studies

items.q: Do all businesses aim only to maximise profit?
items.correct: No — aims vary: survival, growth, market share, social aims.
items.misconception: Yes, profit is every business's only goal.
items.why: Even social enterprises must cover costs; objectives differ between firms.

items.q: Does a sole trader have limited liability?
items.correct: No — sole traders have unlimited liability for business debts.
items.misconception: Yes, sole traders have limited liability.
items.random_wrong: Shareholders of a limited company are personally liable for all debts.
items.why: Limited liability protects shareholders of limited companies; sole traders risk personal assets.
